content: Akristofɔ Ɩlálɛ Ɔkpa Laláhɛsʋ
Mlɩhɔ mlɩ aba Akristofɔá bʋma ɔwʋnlɩ́n hógyitɔ wa mlɩtɔ. Nɩ́ bɛɛ tɔkʋ bʋ alɛ́ ntɛ́ɛ ɩma alɛ a, mlɩmágyi amʋ́ nwɛ́ɛn.
Ɔkʋ lóhogyi ánɩ́ ɔbʋ ɔkpa gyi tógyítɔ́, támɛ ɔkʋ ɛ́ hógyi ɔnɔ́ ɩma ɔnlɩn. Mʋ́ sʋ ɔtamagyi iye.
Ɔkpa má ɩnʋá ɔhá ánɩ́ otegyi tógyítɔ́ ɔbɛ́lɛ ɔhá ánɩ́ ɔtamagyi tɔkʋ ɩlá. Alɩ kɛ́n ɔhá ánɩ́ ɔtamagyi tɔkʋ ɛ́ ɔmálɛ ɔhá ánɩ́ otegyi tógyítɔ́ ɩlá nɩ́. Tsúfɛ́ Bulu lahɔ amʋ́.

Fʋ́gyí ma ánɩ́ fɛ́ha ɔkʋ osúmbi pɔ́n? Mʋ wie nkʋlɛ pɛ́ bʋ́ʋ ɔkpa ánɩ́ ɔbɛ́blɩ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, otsie wankláán ntɛ́ɛ ometsie wankláán. Ɔbɛ́talɩ́ tsíá wankláán, tsúfɛ́ Bulu ɔbɛ́talɩ́ há mʋ obétsiá wankláán.
Ɔkʋ ɔbɛ́talɩ́ blɩ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, ɛkɛ kʋ dʋn mʋ́ aba, ɔkʋ ɛ́ ɔbɛ́blɩ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ nkɛ ámʋ fɛ́ɛ́ igyi kʋlɛ. Ɔhagyíɔha ɔyɔ́ mʋ klʋntɔ wankláán, otsu mʋ́á ɩbʋ alɛ́.

Nɩ́ ɔkʋ ɔlɛ́ ɛkɛ ɔkʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ igyi ɛkɛ yílé á, ɔdɛ mʋ́sʋ́ gyí pʋtsú Bulu fʋ́á. Nɩ́ ɔkʋ ɛ́ tegyi tógyítɔ́ á, ɔdɛ mʋ́ gyí pʋtsú anɩ Wíe fʋ́á. Nɩ́ ɔkʋ ɛ́ tamagyi iye a, mʋ ɛ́ ɔdɛ mʋ́ kisí pʋ́tsú anɩ Wíe fʋ́á. Tsúfɛ́ amʋ́ fɛ́ɛ́ bʋtɛdá Bulu ɩpán mʋ́sʋ́.
Anɩtɔ ɔhaa métsíe nkpa há mʋ ɩwɩ, anɩtɔ ɔkʋkʋ ɛ́ móowu há mʋ ɩwɩ.
Nɩ́ anɩtsie nkpa á, anɩtsie ha anɩ Wíe. Awú ɛ́ á, anɩlawú há mʋ. Mʋ́ sʋ nɩ́ anɩlawú o, anɩtsie nkpa o, anɩ Wíe bʋ́ anɩ.
Tsúfɛ́ Kristo lówu, yínkí kʋ́sʋ́ ba nkpatɔ, mɛ́nɩ ɔbɔ́bwɛ akɩankpapʋ pʋ́ awupʋ́ fɛ́ɛ́ Owíe.
Ɩ́nɩ sʋ imehián ánɩ́ fɛ́ha fʋ́ bá ɩpɔ́n ntɛ́ɛ fɛ́kɩ fʋ́ bá ansɩ́tɔ́ kótíkótí. Tsúfɛ́ anɩ fɛ́ɛ́ abɛ́yɛ́lɩɩ́ Bulu ansɩ́tɔ́, obégyi anɩtɔ okugyíɔkʋ asʋ́n.
Bɔwanlɩ́n wá Bulu asʋ́n ámʋtɔ bɛɛ, “Anɩ Wíe Bulu ɔbɛ́ɛ,

content.text: ɔhagyíɔha ɔbɛ́lɛ blɩ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, Bulu ngyi.’ ”

content: Mʋ́ sʋ anɩtɔ okugyíɔkʋ ɔbɛ́lɛ mʋ asʋ́n ɔnɔ́ Bulu ansɩ́tɔ́.
Máha Fʋ́ Bá Ɔdɩda Mʋ Hógyitɔ
Mʋ́ sʋ mlɩha asi aba ɩlá lɛ. Mboún abwɛ́ɛ agywɩɩn ánɩ́ anɩmɔ́ɔbwɛ tɔtɔá ɩbɛ́ha anɩ bá ɔkʋkʋ mɛ́ɛsrɛɩ́ ntɛ́ɛ dɩda.
Séi ɩ́nɩá namlí Okristoyin sʋ nabɩ́ ánɩ́ atogyihɛ kʋkʋ má ɩnʋá mʋ ɩwɩ mɛtɩn. Támɛ nɩ́ Kristoyin ɔkʋ lóhógyi ánɩ́ tɔkʋ ɩwɩ mɛtɩn a, mʋ́mʋ́ mʋ wá mʋ́ ɩwɩ mɛtɩn.
Nɩ́ fʋ́tegyi tɔkʋ, ɩdɛ fʋ́ bá háan a, mʋ́mʋ́ fʋ́ bwɛhɛ́ mɛdɛ́ ɔdwɛ suná. Máha fʋ́ atogyihɛ ɩha fʋ́ bá ánɩ́ Kristo lówu há mʋ ɔfwɩ.
Mʋ́ sʋ máha tɔ́á fʋyin ánɩ́ ɩbʋ alɛ́ ɩbwɛ tsitsa ahá ansɩ́tɔ́.
Tsúfɛ́ Bulu iwíegyí ámʋ imegyí atogyihɛ ntɛ́ɛ atonuhɛ asʋ́n, mboún yilébwɛ, iwilwii pʋ́ ansigyí ánɩ́ itsú Ɔŋɛ Wankɩ́hɛ́ amʋtɔ asʋ́n igyi.
Ɔhagyíɔha ánɩ́ otosúm Kristo ɔkpa ánfɩsʋ á, mʋ asʋ́n tegyi Bulu ansɩ́. Ahá ɛ́ bʋtobú mʋ.
Ɩ́nɩ sʋ mlɩha anɩ ansɩ́ ɩpɛ tɔ́á ɩbɔ́pʋ iwilwii ba, ɩbɔ́wa apíó aba ɔwʋnlɩ́n hógyitɔsʋ brégyíbrɛ́.
Máyintá Bulu gyumagyihɛ fʋ́ atogyihɛ sʋ. Ɔkpa bʋ ɩnʋá abɛ́talɩ́ gyi tógyítɔ́, támɛ nɩ́ ɔkʋ dɛ́ tɔ́á ɩbɛ́ha mʋ ba ɔbɔ́bwɛ lakpan bwɛ mʋ́ á, ɩma alɛ.
Nɩ́ ɔkʋ tamagyi iye kʋ, ntɛ́ɛ nu ntá ntɛ́ɛ bwɛ́ tɔ́á ɩbɛ́ha mʋ ba ɔbɛ́dɩda á, ɩbʋ alɛ́.
Mʋ́ sʋ tógyítɔ́á fohogyi tsu ntobí ánfɩ ɩwɩ á, ha mʋ́ ɩbwɛ fʋ́á fʋ́ Bulunyɔ nsɩnɛ́ asʋ́n. Nɩ́ ɔkʋ opúni mɛdɛ́ mʋ tsií mʋ bwɛhɛ́sʋ́ á, mʋ́mʋ́ ɔkláa lawá mʋ ogyá.
Támɛ nɩ́ mʋ klʋn mɛdɩ́ mʋ asɩ mʋ atogyihɛ kʋ gyí sʋ, ogyi mʋ́ á, Bulu lahá mʋ ɩpɔ́n dodoodo. Tsúfɛ́ mʋ atɔ́ ámʋ gyí mɛlɩ́ɩ́ hógyisʋ. Tógyítɔ́á ɔha mɔ́pʋ hógyi bwɛ́ igyi lakpan.
